correctness.rationale: PASS: The GP(8,3) graph is explicitly rebuilt on 16 vertices and 24 edges. Exhaustive smallest-unused-vertex recursion and a second bipartite permutation enumeration both give exactly 33 perfect matchings, and their downward closure has 6,051 nonempty faces with face vector (24,228,984,1842,1752,924,264,33). A distinct enumeration of all 11,068 graph matchings with residual perfect-matching feasibility matches the extendible face set. Independently reconstructed the 3,014 staged toggle matching pairs and entire oriented Hasse graph (27,192 covers); topological sorting visits every one of 6,051 faces with critical cells 1 in dimension 0, 9 in dimension 2, 13 in dimension 3. Reconstructed the signed gradient-path Morse matrix from actual face lists; its rational rank is exactly 5 and the asserted 5×5 minor on rows (1,2,3,4,5), columns (0,1,4,5,7) has determinant -1. Hence all five Smith factors are units. The Morse 2-skeleton is a simply connected wedge of nine 2-spheres; π2=H2 identifies all 3-cell attaching maps by integer degrees, and unimodular cancellation gives exactly wedge^4 S² ∨ wedge^8 S³. The finite enumeration is exhaustive for the stated single graph; no infinite graph-family theorem is inferred.
